negative_control.declaration: make the reflex open one repair round per finding; the first case must then observe three rounds

node_definition.done_when: tests/test_one_repair_round_per_review_round.py drives a stored review with three blocking findings and one follow-on finding through the reflex for an unpromoted run whose worker has exited, and observes one repair round opened and the reviewed run resumed once, with advice naming all three blocking findings and not the follow-on. A second case retries a failed resume and finds the retry recorded as another attempt of the same round, not a second round. The negative control makes the reflex open one round per finding, and the first case then observes three. First check whether such a test already exists at main and add only what is missing. The test files importing reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py or reckon.crew.recovery show no added failure against base, run in place on the fleet allocation with pytest -n 8, each log starting with its revision and the literal command and ending in EXIT=, under the run directory. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the test file, recorded in a log. If the test exposes a defect in reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py, stop blocked and name it: that file is claimed by another run.
node_definition.goal: Prove with a test that a review with three blocking findings and one follow-on opens one repair round that resumes the reviewed run once with advice naming the three blocking findings
